name: openai
description: OpenAI provider module: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions model routing across the gpt-4o-mini (flash-class) and gpt-4o (pro-class) tiers, serving Copilot and enterprise GPT deployments through a per-deployment base_url override, with cloud-to-local (Ollama) graceful degradation.

features.desc: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions chat with Bearer auth and typed output validation.
LOW/MED route to gpt-4o-mini, HIGH/MAX to gpt-4o, chosen from the issue-#9 tier ladder.
The same adapter serves Copilot and any enterprise GPT deployment by overriding base_url per deployment/tenant.
Cloud-to-local fallback to the keyless local Ollama hop when the primary is unavailable.

provenance.note: Gateway-owned module-catalog entry (issue #349) for the registered `openai` provider adapter. Pattern only; the OpenAI-compatible provider-gateway shape and the provider-neutral classifier vocabulary were re-implemented for this repo's Python substrate, no source file was copied.
